Note: The recalibrated values in Panel A were fitted within each cohort and are in-sample; they describe the local calibration ceiling in that cohort and must not be read as achievable external performance. Transportability is assessed separately in Supplemental Methods S9: the slope was nearly identical in test cohorts 1 and 2 (1.1268 and 1.1260), and applying the test-1 parameters to test cohort 2 gave slope 0.999, H-L P 0.501 and Brier 0.078 (versus 0.089 without recalibration), close to the 0.077 and 0.562 obtained by fitting within test cohort 2. The intercept differed by 0.45 log-odds, consistent with a difference in case-mix prevalence rather than with parameter estimation error. Recalibration fitted in the training cohort alone (10-fold out-of-fold, a = -0.052, b = 0.928) changed the pooled validation Brier only from 0.0997 to 0.1000.
